steps.evidence: 43/43 offline + 19/19 LIVE: a phone call produced PR #1 on enriquealonso01/s22-call-mtk4gjzz, confirmed by the GitHub API, with the completion report carrying the link. CORRECTION 2026-09-02: the 'context across turns' clause of this evidence overclaimed and Enrique was right to challenge it. What that assertion actually tests is that the fourth turn was asked with MORE MESSAGES in front of it than the first - it counts rows. It never asserts that a fact stated in turn 1 is usable in turn 3, and the path that decides what a turn MEANS is a different code path entirely: classifyInbox, which received only the current utterance and no history at all until the voice-create fix. steps.title: Project onboarding and `AGENTS.md`
steps.evidence: Built and tested. Onboarding renders AGENTS.md from the template or refuses and names what is missing - no code path substitutes a default, and 'none' is a real answer while blank is not. The canonical row goes to project_instructions_versions v1 (ADR 018: the row is canonical, the committed file is a rendering of it). githubPutFile commits it into the repository. A professional project is refused a free consumer account, with the tier derived from auth_type/metered_spend_allowed rather than a list of provider names, and the broker refuses it again at use. 52 offline assertions plus 11 LIVE against enriquealonso01/jarvis-s26-fixture, where the committed bytes equal the canonical row exactly. Seen red three times (13, 3, then 6). BLOCKED on the Done-when, which says VOICE: nothing has yet created a project by being spoken to. Also blocked-adjacent: every auth profile is seeded {normal} eligibility, so a confidential project can use no credential at all. Both in BLOCKED.md. VOICE PATH (2026-09-02, after a failed live attempt): five defects found above the tool layer, plus one of mine and one silent constraint. All fixed with tests that start where the voice does - an end-to-end through ingestUserMessage (19 assertions) and the six real utterances through the LIVE classifier on the box (4 assertions): turn 1 now create_project where production said capture, and the fragments stay on subject using the conversation history.

steps.title: Configuration by conversation
steps.evidence: Built and tested. applyConfigChange is the only way configuration changes - versioning, provenance and audit are the same statement as the write - and the suite proves that architecturally by reading src/ and asserting exactly one file INSERTs into either version table. It found two bypasses when written (the schedule route and S26 onboarding), both now routed through it. Migration 029 adds the conversation and his own words to both version tables and scopes the version sequence to (project, key), which was previously global per key. The section 59 immutable list is data, refuses, and raises an approval rather than discarding the ask; ambiguity returns one question and writes nothing; rollback restores a value exactly as a NEW version. Tools resolve the project from what he NAMED, not the conversation. 85 assertions, seen red three times (30, 7, 1). BLOCKED on the Done-when: it needs a spoken sentence, and 'auditable a week later' is so far proved by backdating a row, which tests the query and not the passage of time. See BLOCKED.md.
